label: help
js: Kit.help.open(); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); Kit.help.close(); r(JSON.stringify(u)); }, 300))

label: ready
js: game.start({ level: 'easy' }); game.step(0.5); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: go + buddy
js: game.step(1.5); game.put(0, 2, 2); game.call(); game.step(1.5); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: pops
js: (() => { game.step(6); game.quiet(); game.put(0, 2, 1); game.setWin(0, 3, 1, 'shut'); const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.6); k('ArrowUp', 0); const win = game.setWin(0, 3, 2, 'open'); win.kind = 'busy'; game.put(0, 2, 2); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.2); win.t = 0.001; game.step(0.6); k('ArrowUp', 0); const w = game.world(); w.towers[0].dropT = 0; game.step(0.4); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: bonk + row + dodge
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); game.quiet(); game.put(0, 3, 2); w.towers[0].drops.push({ id: 990, kind: 'duck', who: 2, c: 2, row: 5, x: 0, y: 3 * 1.7 + 2.4, st: 'fall', t: 0, warnT: 1, vy: 0, spin: 0, hit: false, passed: false }); w.towers[0].drops.push({ id: 991, kind: 'ball', who: 1, c: 3, row: 5, x: 1.6, y: 3 * 1.7 + 2.4, st: 'fall', t: 0, warnT: 1, vy: 0, spin: 0, hit: false, passed: false, aimed: true }); game.step(0.8); game.put(0, 3, 1); game.setWin(0, 4, 1, 'open'); const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.8); k('ArrowUp', 0); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: top + heli + next building
js: (() => { game.resume(); game.quiet(); const w = game.world(); game.put(0, w.towers[0].L.rows - 1, 2); const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.9); k('ArrowUp', 0); game.step(1); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: next building
js: game.step(4); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().bi, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300))

label: extra life
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.players[0].score = 9990; game.put(0, 1, 2); game.setWin(0, 2, 2, 'open'); w.towers[0].p.best = 1; const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); game.step(2); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.8); k('ArrowUp', 0); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: 1P game over results
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.players[0].lives = 1; game.quiet(); game.put(0, 3, 2); w.towers[0].drops.push({ id: 992, kind: 'pillow', who: 3, c: 2, row: 5, x: 0, y: 3 * 1.7 + 2.4, st: 'fall', t: 0, warnT: 1, vy: 0, spin: 0, hit: false, passed: false }); game.step(5.5); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().screen, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: 2P hi5 + first
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 2, go: true }); game.quiet(); game.call(); game.step(0.3); const w = game.world(); game.put(0, w.towers[0].L.rows - 1, 2); const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); k('KeyW', 1); game.step(0.9); k('KeyW', 0); game.step(0.5); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: 2P win results
js: (() => { const W = game.world(); WC.sim.loadBuilding(W, 3); W.phase = 'play'; game.quiet(); game.put(0, W.towers[0].L.rows - 1, 2); game.put(1, W.towers[1].L.rows - 1, 2); const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); k('KeyW', 1); game.step(0.9); k('KeyW', 0); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.9); k('ArrowUp', 0); game.step(5.5); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().screen, document.getElementById('resTitle').textContent, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: 1P win results
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 1, go: true }); const W = game.world(); WC.sim.loadBuilding(W, 3); W.phase = 'play'; game.quiet(); game.put(0, W.towers[0].L.rows - 1, 2); const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.9); k('ArrowUp', 0); game.step(5.5); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().screen, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: english: no CJK
js: (() => { Kit.lang.set('en'); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const all = [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e => !e.closest('#kit-lang-btn') && !e.closest('#kit-help') && !e.closest('[data-no-lang]')).map(e => [...e.childNodes].filter(n => n.nodeType === 3).map(n => n.textContent).join('') + ' ' + (e.getAttribute('title') || '') + ' ' + (e.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')).join(' '); const cjk = all.match(/[\u3400-\u9fff]+/g); r(JSON.stringify({ cjk: cjk ? [...new Set(cjk)].slice(0, 10) : [], logo: document.getElementById('logoText').textContent })); }, 400)); })()

label: english help panel
js: Kit.help.open(); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const t = document.getElementById('kit-help').innerText; Kit.help.close(); r(JSON.stringify((t.match(/[\u3400-\u9fff]+/g) || []).slice(0, 5))); }, 300))
